verdict.rationale: Scoped API credentials are a fair axis for a payments API platform like Mangopay. The evidence only shows a client_id used in SDK configuration, an 'API CREDENTIALS' dashboard section and mTLS support for SCA. None of these documents scoped, permission-limited or least-privilege keys that could be issued to an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
